end.summary:
Practised how roots hold soil during rain and reduce soil loss.
Discussed Bishnoi communities in Rajasthan and sacred groves.
Gave examples of protecting nature through not cutting trees and leaving special forests undisturbed.
The idea that only governments can protect nature appeared and was not clearly corrected later.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how roots hold soil in place during rain, along with examples of Bishnoi communities and sacred groves. Dev gave several explanations of roots holding soil and named two traditional nature-protection practices. Dev also said that only the government can save trees; this mix-up was not clearly corrected later in the lesson.
